# has geometry

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasGeometry`](gmeow-hasGeometry.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasGeometry>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Relates a place to its spatial geometry (point, line, or polygon). Flat shortcut for the common case; the full relator form is a [`CoordinateObservation`](../classes/gmeow-CoordinateObservation.md) linking the place to a [`Geometry`](../classes/gmeow-Geometry.md) result via [`gmeow:geometryResult`](gmeow-geometryResult.md), carrying provenance, reference frame, confidence, and standpoint ([Principle 3](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-3)). Non-simple: derived via property chain from the reified observation path.
